Name: More Content for Central Station
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
Adds new content to Central Station! Storyline, new locations, new tourists, etc.

(Formely named Central Station Expanded)



[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.1.8+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/v4X7fpHc/storyline-5.png[/img]
As of 2.0.0, this mod has a storyline. Here is a guide for it.
﻿﻿
﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/bM7BgsKj/event-1-the-missing-spellbook.png[/img]﻿
[b][i]﻿ ﻿Prerequisites: 2 Hearts w/ the Wizard & must have visited the Underground Shops[/i][/b]
﻿﻿The Wizard will show up at your door, you will get the quest.
﻿﻿
﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/DPp5C6vT/finding-the-spellbook.png[/img] [img]https://i.ibb.co/SwkcgXtb/20250928105638-1-1-30.jpg[/img]
[b][i] ﻿﻿Located directly south of the big tree next to Marnie's. [/i][/b]
[size=2] ﻿﻿Tile: Forest 53, 43 ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[/size]
﻿
﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/5gRmFscp/event-2-the-spell.png[/img]
﻿﻿ ﻿After you ﻿﻿give the spellbook to the Wizard, he will say to check your mail. The letter will say to meet him at the Underground Shops; go there.
﻿It will go through a cutscene where the Wizard opens a cave for you to go in. This cave has certain cool things, like shops, a portal thing, etc. More info below.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/m5V420pz/the-secret-cave.png[/img]
﻿As I mentioned before, this cave has cool random events. These include:

[list]
[*][b][i]Tuesdays, Thursdays (in game days)[/i][/b]: A mysterious shop, which uses a new currency called [b][i]Silver Coins[/i][/b]. There is more info in the section below.
[*][b][i]Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays (in game days)[/i][/b]: A portal to an underground dungeon...
[/list]

﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/pjZsr9Wj/silver-coins-currency-export.png[/img]﻿
﻿﻿You can get [b]Silver Coins [/b]by defeating monsters in the Underground Dungeon, which you get to by stepping onto the red warp thing.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url].
Put the [CP] More Content for Central Station folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Load Stardew Valley using SMAPI.﻿
